title: miRPNI · human graft and residual-muscle EMG
citation: Nwokeabia, C. et al. (2026). miRPNI: A dataset of intramuscular electromyography from Regenerative Peripheral Nerve Interfaces and residual muscles. Version 8.0. doi:10.5281/zenodo.23377398.
processing: Original acquisition 30 kHz. Authors release 1 kHz resampled, band-pass and notch-filtered EMG. This excerpt preserves the CSV numerical values without further filtering, smoothing, scaling or resampling. Three first repetitions, source samples 4000–7999 of each 8-second trial.

provenance.selection: First trial of thumb, index-finger and small-finger flexion; last 4 seconds of each trial. This retains 1 second of rest followed by 3 seconds of cued movement.
provenance.channelMap: P1_meta.zip/meta/P1_metadata.json; source channel numbers retained; no geometric positions released here.
provenance.amplitudeUnits: CSV and README do not define a calibrated unit. Companion MATLAB script contains a commented µV ylabel, insufficient to establish calibration; values are explicitly labeled source units.

sourceFiles.integrity: Member CRC32 verified; full archive MD5 not downloaded/verified.
Member CRC32 verified; full archive MD5 not downloaded/verified.

limitations: These are muscle signals from reinnervated grafts and residual muscles, not direct single-axon recordings.
Movement labels are prompts, not decoder predictions or measured prosthetic motion.
This is one participant and session, not a population summary or claim of device performance.
Amplitude calibration is not established by the supplied CSV metadata; no voltage-unit conversion is applied.
